name: YouTube Transcript
verdict: No customer connection: call the transcript API with your own key (100 free credits, then $5/month); it reads public videos. Official YouTube captions access needs the video owner's Google OAuth consent; under a day.
needGuide: No — sign up, create an API key and call it server-side; customers connect nothing.

auth.detail: TranscriptAPI is a third-party hosted REST API (not a YouTube or Google product). Keys start with `sk_` and are sent as `Authorization: Bearer API_KEY`, created in the dashboard's API Keys page. No Google or YouTube Data API key is needed. OAuth applies only to its MCP server (https://transcriptapi.com/mcp) for Claude and ChatGPT, and only for that connector. The official YouTube Data API captions endpoint needs Google OAuth (scope youtube.force-ssl) and is limited to videos the user owns or can edit; this comes from the brief and prior knowledge, not a doc fetched this session.

approval.gate: None. Credits and rate limits apply: 100 free credits on signup, then $5/month for 1,000 credits (200 RPM) or $54/year (300 RPM). HTTP 402 means no credits or no active plan.

scopes.why: The transcript API has no scopes (the official YouTube Data API's force-ssl scope is sensitive).
scopes.summary: TranscriptAPI has no scopes. For the official YouTube Data API, youtube.force-ssl is a sensitive scope that likely triggers Google OAuth verification (not confirmed in this session).

steps.do: Sign up at transcriptapi.com and create an API key on the API Keys page.
Store the key server-side and call GET /api/v2/youtube/transcript with the video URL or ID and `Authorization: Bearer sk_...`.
Handle 401 (bad key), 402 (no credits or plan) and 429 (honor Retry-After).
Optionally connect the MCP server at https://transcriptapi.com/mcp (OAuth for Claude and ChatGPT, API key for others).
If you must read captions for videos your user owns, add Google OAuth with youtube.force-ssl and the YouTube Data API captions endpoints (needs Google verification).
Review terms of use for third-party transcript scraping and caching.

roles.team: Anyone with a company email who owns the billing; keys are account-wide.
roles.customer: None. Customers do not connect an account because the API reads public video transcripts. For the official YouTube Data API route, the video owner or editor must grant Google OAuth consent.

testing: Free routes exist for latest-uploads RSS and handle resolution.
Rate limit is per account across all keys.

blockers.problem: Official YouTube captions API only works for videos the user owns or edits

automation.humanMust: Sign up, add payment, accept terms, and complete Google OAuth verification if using the YouTube Data API.
